coordinate_frame: Map convention (schema_eco.md, gen_books_eco.py ROOM_PLAN): room-local metres, x from the W wall (0) to the E wall, z from the N wall (0) to the S wall, so the vestibule door is in the S wall at x 1.0-1.9 and the vestibule hangs below (z 7.4+). The salotto plan is fixed by ROOM_PLAN at 6.5 x 7.0 m (layout approx_size_m is overridden), so the true room (about 7.5 x 7.6 m) is drawn compressed by 0.87 in x and 0.92 in z; every wall sequence keeps its order. Wall positions: N/S walls measured from the W end, E/W walls from the N end (wall_point convention). Film frames: zZEy10fpq3I names are raw labels, true time = label + 0.96 s (timestamp_s below is the true second the link jumps to).

notes: Chirality check: entering from the vestibule and facing the windows, the statue and the vitrines are on the LEFT (W wall), the curiosity cabinet and door 2 on the RIGHT (E wall), the piano behind on the door wall (left of the door as one faces it). The current map is mirrored: it has the vitrines on the E wall and the piano on the W wall.

The other thread's files (salotto_layout.json, salotto_objects.json, notes.md, crops/) use a frame with z from the window wall up to the door wall and x from the W to the E with the door at the E end: x_map = (7.5 - x_other) * 6.5/7.5, z_map = z_other * 7.0/7.6. Their 'door moves to the NE corner' and 'windows swap to the wall opposite the door' are the same geometry as this file: in the map the door stays in the S wall and the windows on the N wall.

Disagreements resolved by frames: (1) the 'fine' canvas, the prints column and the side cabinet are on the W wall between the door corner and the statue (74:13 shows door - prints - canvas - statue in that order from the sofa side), not on the door wall E of the door as first read from 00:49; (2) the white door with the handle beside the statue's leg at 64:00 and the closed white door with two switches seen at 74:03 and in the 2015 walk are the vestibule door itself, not a second door on the S wall; (3) the credenza with the CDs/hi-fi is a different piece from the glazed curiosity cabinet salotto-wood (05:07 pan, Curti Parini photo): credenza W wall behind the cases, cabinet E wall.

Not settled: the piano's wall (S wall E part chosen, low-medium); whether the bright opening behind cases 1-2 is a window or a glazed door; where door 2 leads; whether the window-wall chrome lamp is the door-2 lamp moved; the hook of the beach photograph and of the white-framed print.
Free-standing objects here are in the compressed 6.5 x 7.0 plan; true-size positions are those of salotto_objects.json (other thread) with the conversion above.
